lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observed cluster of approximately 20-25 circular high-luminance nodes (local maxima) positioned posterior to the branchial region, exhibiting a semi-rectilinear distribution along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical zones of increased pixel intensity intersect the circular nodes at near-right angles, forming an orthogonal grid-like structure across the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges with distinct shadow-to-highlight transitions (light superior margin, dark inferior margin) extending longitudinally across the dorsal-lateral quadrant.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several elongated high-luminance objects with distinct orientations clustered around the pectoral fin and along the ventral-lateral boundary.
